items.title: 52157_Count Basie oral history interview
items.q: I knew he had to be with me.

ctx.x: What did you think of Sammy Davis that show, that --

Geez, I'd never seen anything like it. I first saw him down in -- first time I saw him was down in Memphis and I never seen anything like it, like him. And I just knew I had to see him. I knew he had to be with me. It was grand.
